entities.name: Devil
entities.description: A primarily red creature type of wicked, ill-tempered evil spirits, subordinate to Demons.

entities.name: Demon
entities.description: Greater evil spirits to whom devils are subordinate.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara where devils surround themselves with the undead.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane where devils are associated with the red-aligned crime families.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: A red-aligned crime family of New Capenna.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A red-aligned crime family of New Capenna.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: A red-aligned crime family of New Capenna.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane home to devils accompanying greater demons.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A failed skaberen transformed into a half-devil by a spell taught by devils.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where devils are part of the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The cult led by Rakdos, to which Ravnican devils belong.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Leader of the Cult of Rakdos.

events.summary: Tibalt, a failed skaberen, becomes a half-devil through a spell taught by devils, using it to defend himself from a mob.
events.quote: The failed skaberen Tibalt was transformed into a half-devil through a spell that was taught to him by devils

relations.note: Demons employ devils as torturers and slave drivers on Grixis.
relations.quote: Demons employ devils as torturers, slave drivers, and masters of packs of undead

relations.note: On Ravnica devils are part of the cult.
relations.quote: On Ravnica , devils are part of the Cult of Rakdos .
